CHAPTER 11.20
INSURANCE ACT
(Acts 5 of 2001, 6 of 2005, 3 of 2008, 9 of 2011, S.R.Os. 22/2004,
60/2010 and 6/2012)
AN ACT TO MAKE PROVISION FOR REGULATING THE CARRYING ON OF
INSURANCE BUSINESS AND REGULATING THE OPERATION OF PENSION FUND
PLANS IN MONTSERRAT AND FOR RELATED MATTERS.
Commencement
[26 June 2003]
PART 1
PRELIMINARY
Short title
1. This Act may be cited as the Insurance Act.
Interpretation
2. (1) In this Act—
“actuary” means a person who satisfies the Supervisor that he—
(a) is a Fellow of a professional body of actuaries that is
internationally recognised; or
(b) is a person of equivalent status to that of a Fellow mentioned in
paragraph (a); or
(c) a person recognised by the Minister as having actuarial
knowledge and experience;
“admissible assets” means such assets as may from time to time be prescribed
to be admissible assets;
“assets” does not include goodwill;
“association of underwriters” means either—
(a) the association of underwriters known as Lloyd’s; or
(b) an association of individual or corporate underwriters in which
every underwriting member of a syndicate becomes liable for a
separate part of the sum secured by each policy subscribed to
by that syndicate, limited or proportionate to the whole sum
thereby secured;

Supervisor of Insurance
4. (1) For the purposes of this Act there shall be a Supervisor of Insurance
who shall be responsible for the general administration of this Act.
(2) The Minister shall designate an officer in the Ministry of Finance to
be the Supervisor of Insurance.
(3) In the exercise of his powers and the performance of his duties, the
Supervisor shall comply with any special directions given to him in writing by
the Minister.
Supervisor may secure services of persons
5. The Supervisor may obtain the services of, an actuary or any competent
person for the purpose of carrying out any survey, investigation, inquiry or
functions under this Act.
Delegation by Supervisor
6. (1) The Supervisor may delegate on such terms and conditions as he
deems fit, to any person employed in the Ministry of Finance, all or any of his
powers or duties under this Act except the power conferred on him by this
section.
(2) Any delegation under subsection (1) shall be revocable at any time
by the Supervisor and no delegation shall prevent the exercise of such powers

Restriction on carrying on insurance business
9. (1) Subject to this Act, no person may carry on or purport to carry on,
insurance business in Montserrat, unless that person—
(a) is a company, or an association of underwriters, and registered
under this Act; and
(b) has—
(i) made the deposit required by section 22; and
(ii) filed with the Supervisor the names and addresses of one or
more persons resident in Montserrat and authorised to
accept on behalf of the company service of process in legal
proceedings.
(Amended by Act 3 of 2008)
(2) A company which contravenes this section is guilty of an offence
and is liable on summary conviction to a fine of $100,000.
